summary: Zion and her daughters will be redeemed and cleansed in the millennial day—Compare 2 Nephi 14.
meta_description: Zion and her daughters will be redeemed and cleansed in the millennial day—Compare 2 Nephi 14.

footnotes.note1_a: IE because of scarcity of men due to wars. See Isa. 3:25.
footnotes.note1_d: IE the stigma of being unmarried and childless. TG Reproach.
footnotes.note2_c: IE the earth will be renewed, and will be productive, prosperous, and beautiful.
footnotes.note3_d: IE those saved by approval of the Messiah. TG Record Keeping.
footnotes.note4_a: IE When the Lord has cleansed the earth (v. 4), He will set up His dwelling and His protective presence here (vv. 5–6).
footnotes.note4_c: TG Millennium, Preparing a People for.
